account-wide-agent-grant-01.graded_text: The design gives the agent connection a scope covering every workspace the person belongs to now or later plus documents shared with them individually, and does not make the person pick one organization per connection.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:60 "An MCP connection is an **account-wide grant**: it covers every workspace the person belongs to now or later, plus every document shared with them individually." Line 63: "New workspaces don't need a reconnect." No per-organization pick in consent; the per-workspace option is only a possible later addition (line 197).

account-wide-agent-grant-02.graded_text: Every tool call resolves the target workspace or document and checks live membership, role, and individual share on the server at call time. A single organization claim in a token is not treated as proof of access to any other workspace.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:83-87 per-call steps "2. Find the target: the document by `id` ... or the workspace by `workspace_id` for creates. 3. Load the caller's **live** membership in that workspace and any share of that document. 4. Check the capability ..."; line 64 "The token's organization claim, if the provider includes one, is ignored when choosing a target. It proves nothing about any other workspace."

account-wide-agent-grant-03.graded_text: The create tool takes an explicit destination workspace ID, and the server verifies the caller may create in that workspace before creating. The design does not say a client-supplied workspace ID must never be used.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:100 "`create_document { workspace_id, title, content? }` ... `document.create` in `workspace_id`"; line 105 "`workspace_id` is **required** and has no default"; line 106 "The caller needs Editor or Owner in that workspace." Nothing forbids using a client-supplied workspace ID; the closest line, 120 "The workspace is always taken from the document itself, never from an argument", applies only to read/update.

account-wide-agent-grant-04.graded_text: Removing a membership or an individual share takes effect for an already connected agent without reconnecting.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:63 "Leaving a workspace, losing a share, or being demoted takes effect on the next call with the existing token, because every call checks again."; line 189 "Revoking a membership or share takes effect immediately in the app and over MCP".

account-wide-agent-grant-05.graded_text: An individually shared document gives access to that document only, never to its workspace's other documents or member list, through the UI and the agent alike.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:21 Share gives "That one document only. Not its workspace's other documents, member list, or settings"; line 117 "Shared results leave the workspace out"; line 111 list_workspaces "never includes workspaces the person reaches only through shares"; line 106 share-only access cannot create in the workspace; line 156 an unknown or not-allowed /w/ segment shows a no-access screen.

account-wide-agent-grant-06.graded_text: The library shows documents from every workspace the person belongs to by default, with workspace and shared filters held in URL query state, filters only narrow what is shown, and no active-workspace session state is introduced as an authority for browsing or for the agent connection.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:143 "The header has **no active-workspace switcher**."; line 166 `workspace` param "Absent means: all workspaces and shares"; line 172 "The filter is only a way of browsing. It never authorizes anything and never decides where a new document goes"; line 9 "No active workspace is stored in a session, cookie, or client memory." The provider active org set on /w/ pages (line 156) follows the URL and is not used for browsing or the agent.

account-wide-agent-grant-07.graded_text: The design introduces no per-seat price and no paid seat gate, and leaves the member cap of 25 as the brief states it. A design that does not discuss billing or the cap passes.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:53 "**Member cap of 25.** The gate enforces the cap when an invitation is sent."; line 54 "Plans are priced on storage, not workspaces." Checked docs/workspace-access.md and answer.txt: they contain no per-seat price or paid seat gate.

account-wide-agent-grant-08.graded_text: The design says the consent screen states the connection's scope, including workspaces joined later.

votes.e: A/project/docs/workspace-access.md:62 "The consent screen says so plainly: 'This agent will be able to act on your behalf in all your Alderdocs workspaces, including ones you join later, and on documents shared with you.'"
